name: kaeri-plugin-store
description: A Kaeri plugin store on Cloudflare Workers, D1 and R2.

KAERI_STORE_SETUP_CODE.description: A code you choose, which claims the store from its admin page at `/admin/` while nobody owns it yet. Make it long and random, for example the output of `openssl rand -hex 16`, and keep it to yourself.

KAERI_STORE_NAME.description: The store's name, as the people you invite see it in Kaeri.

DB.description: The D1 database that keeps the store's members, invites and plugin list.

FILES.description: The R2 bucket that keeps the plugin files.
